overview.title: Harbour and seafront promenade
overview.p1: The port and corniche are the everyday seafront of Al Hoceima — fishing boats, evening walks and simple seafood near the water.
overview.p2: It links town beach life with the working harbour. Ideal for a short stroll, photos at golden hour and a meal stop.
overview.p3: Combine easily with Quemado Beach on the same day.

q1.question: Far from Quemado Beach?
q1.answer: No — the seafront links town beach life with the harbour area on foot or a very short ride.

q2.question: Safe in the evening?
q2.answer: Stick to the main lit promenade; usual town precautions apply.

q3.question: Best for photos?
q3.answer: Golden hour and blue hour over the harbour and bay.

q4.question: Where to eat?
q4.answer: Simple seafood places cluster near the port; prices vary — check before you sit.

q5.question: How long?
q5.answer: One to two hours for a walk and a meal stop is enough for most visits.
